page: Microsoft Azure D4plds_v6 is an ARM-based virtual machine belonging to the Dpldsv6 server family. It features 4 dedicated physical cores powered by a Microsoft ARM Neoverse-N2 processor running at 3.4 GHz. The system is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 2.0 GB per core allocation. It includes 236 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable, operating under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

Benchmark results show average performance across most standard workloads. The single-core and multi-core stress-ng tests score 2074.79 and 8275.96 respectively, placing them in the middle tier of tested hardware. Single-threaded gzip compression is a notable highlight, achieving a strong 33.06 GB/sec. However, cryptographic performance is poor, with the PassMark CPU encryption test scoring 741.37. Memory bandwidth is measured at 453.63 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 90.93 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads.

Given its 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this server represents a cost-efficient option for compute-centric workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. The inclusion of 236 GB of local storage provides a resource-dense configuration for temporary data handling. It is well-suited for tasks such as static web serving, software compilation, and light database operations, but less optimal for memory-intensive applications or heavy cryptographic processing.
